apps.localizedDescription: NBA 2K24 Arcade Edition – become an NBA superstar with MyCareer, play to win fans and get the support of iconic brands like Nike, Jordan or Adidas. Unlock NBA Legends to join your streetball team, fight artificial intelligence and earn virtual capital that you can use to unlock new shoes, accessories, outfits and tattoos (for the first time in Apple Arcade). Challenge in the “Greatest” mode and discover a whole new line-up of NBA superstars and legends. Create a team of your wildest dreams and fight with other GOAT squads in a decisive battle in the Greatest Fantasy Team Challenge.
